title: Not wood, not ceramic, nothing like the picture, it's clear acrylic...
text: Not wood, not ceramic, nothing like the picture, it's clear acrylic.... Not sure how I allowed my brain to think that for $9, I could get a hand carved heart with tiny hand carved books. LOL! The stock photo is 5-stars! The stock picture really pops, and it seems like you're getting a detailed wooden ornament. You're not! It's not ceramic either. You're getting a a clear acrylic ornament with a double sided picture placed/printed on top of one side of the heart. The image of the books is placed on the outside, so when you flip the heart over, the text "just a girl..." is below the acrylic. It's even see through, you can see your fingers with just a little light. My fault for not completely reading the product description, so I won't be too harsh. But they should change their product photo because it really is an embellishment of what you'll see in reality. They're only setting themselves up for upset customers. 3-Stars.
